deliveryGates.requirement: Select a retained package and supported course without editing scripts; bind all execution stages to the intended build.
Retain acceptance evidence for wrong responses, changed fixtures, failed ingest and interrupted mutation; required output checks reject deliberately wrong results.
Validate owned desktop control and real save/quit/relaunch/reopen on the supported package configuration.
One real human/Oz handoff survives interruption and resumes from a verified checkpoint; preserve human failures.
Publish a readable report and accessible evidence with retry-safe run identity, including failed and incomplete runs.
Deliver an accurate categorized summary linked to the report without duplicate messages.
Optional Build + Smoke and a workstation kit run on another machine; CI does not wait for a person.
Another developer repeats the complete workflow; record automation duration and actual human effort.

manualEffortBaseline.note: The workbook records outcomes, not elapsed time. Do not infer time savings.
